title: Mirror Tummy Time
description: Körpənin özünü güzgüdə görməsi inkişafı stimullaşdırır
instructions: Körpəni qarnı üstə yastığın üzərinə qoyun. Önünə güzgü yerləşdirin. Ona güzgüdə özünü göstərin.

title: Kitchen Band
instructions: Taxta qaşıq və qazanları körpənin önünə qoyun. Necə vuracağını göstərin. Birlikdə ritm yaradın.

title: Box Tunnel
instructions: Böyük karton qutunun hər iki tərəfini açın. Körpəni bir tərəfdən sürünməyə həvəsləndirin. Digər tərəfdən onu səsləyin.

title: Sock Puppets
instructions: Köhnə corabdan kukla düzəldin. Körpə ilə "danışın". Müxtəlif səslər çıxarın.

title: Texture Walk
instructions: Müxtəlif toxumalı materialları (yorğan, şərf, kağız) yerə düzün. Körpənin üzərindən sürünməsinə icazə verin.

title: High Contrast Cards
description: Black and white pattern cards for visual development
instructions: 1. Hold the card 20-30cm from babys face\n2. Move slowly left to right\n3. Watch babys eyes follow the card

title: Tummy Time with Mirror
description: Tummy time using mirror for engagement
instructions: 1. Place baby on tummy on soft surface\n2. Put mirror in front of baby\n3. Talk and encourage baby to look up

title: Gentle Massage Time
description: Baby massage for bonding and development
instructions: 1. Use baby-safe oil\n2. Gently massage arms, legs, and tummy\n3. Sing or talk while massaging

title: Bubble Watching
instructions: 1. Blow bubbles near baby\n2. Point at bubbles and describe them\n3. Let bubbles pop on babys skin gently

title: Texture Exploration
instructions: 1. Gather items with different textures\n2. Let baby touch each item\n3. Describe the textures: soft, rough, smooth

title: Container Play
description: Putting objects in and out of containers
instructions:
1. Use a safe container and soft toys
2. Show baby how to put items in
3. Encourage baby to take items out
4. Celebrate with clapping

title: Ball Rolling
description: Rolling a ball back and forth
instructions:
1. Sit facing baby
2. Roll soft ball to baby
3. Encourage baby to push it back
4. Cheer when baby participates

title: Peek-a-Boo with Cloth
instructions:
1. Cover your face with cloth
2. Say "Where am I?"
3. Remove cloth and say "Peek-a-boo!"
4. Cover babys face gently and repeat

title: Black & White Mobile
instructions: Cut simple shapes from paper, hang them 20-30cm above baby. Let baby track the movement.

title: Stacking Cups
instructions:
1. Show baby how to stack cups
2. Let baby knock them down
3. Rebuild and repeat
4. Name colors as you stack

title: Picture Book Reading
instructions:
1. Choose books with bright pictures
2. Point to pictures and name them
3. Let baby turn pages
4. Make animal sounds

title: Shape Sorter
instructions:
1. Show how shapes fit into holes
2. Guide babys hand at first
3. Celebrate success
4. Name shapes as you play

title: Dance Party
instructions:
1. Play fun music
2. Dance with baby in arms
3. Put baby down and dance together
4. Clap and spin

title: Rattle Tracking
description: Visual and auditory tracking with rattle
instructions: 1. Shake rattle to get babys attention\n2. Move it slowly in different directions\n3. Let baby try to grab it

title: Pretend Phone Call
instructions:
1. Give baby a toy phone
2. Pretend to call baby
3. Encourage baby to "talk"
4. Take turns speaking

title: Gentle Singing
instructions: Hold baby close and sing gentle lullabies or simple songs. Watch for baby responding to your voice.

title: Tummy Time with Toys
description: Place colorful toys in front during tummy time
instructions: Place baby on tummy. Put colorful toys just out of reach to encourage reaching and head lifting.

title: Splash Time
description: Let baby splash water with hands
instructions: Fill a shallow bowl with warm water. Let baby touch and splash. Always supervise closely.

title: Flying Baby
description: Gently lift baby in the air
instructions: Lie on your back, hold baby securely and gently lift them up like flying. Great for bonding.

title: Treasure Basket
description: Fill a basket with safe household objects
instructions: Collect 5-10 safe items of different textures, shapes. Let baby explore freely, naming each object.

title: Clap Hands Song
instructions: Sing simple clapping songs. Help baby clap their hands together. Great for rhythm and coordination.

title: Spoon Drop Game
instructions: Show baby how to drop wooden spoons into a pot. Let them hear the sound and repeat.

title: Cotton Ball Transfer
instructions: Give baby two bowls and cotton balls. Show how to pick up and transfer them. Great for fine motor skills.

title: Paper Tearing
instructions: Give baby soft paper to tear. The sound and feeling builds sensory awareness and hand strength.

title: Cardboard Tube Tunnel
instructions: Hold a cardboard tube and show baby how to roll a small ball through it. Chase after the ball together.

title: Sponge Squeeze
instructions: Wet sponges and show baby how to squeeze water into a bowl. Great for hand strength.

title: Feather Blowing
description: Blow feathers and watch them float
instructions: Place feathers on a flat surface. Blow gently and let baby try to catch or blow them too.

title: Sand Play
instructions: Fill a tray with sand. Give cups and spoons. Let baby dig, pour, and feel the texture.

title: Play Dough Squish
description: Squish, roll and shape play dough
instructions: Give baby play dough. Show squishing, rolling, poking. Use cookie cutters for shapes.

title: Block Tower
description: Stack blocks as high as possible
instructions: Show baby how to stack blocks. Count each block. Celebrate when the tower falls! Rebuild together.

title: Scarf Pull
instructions: Stuff scarves into a box with a hole. Let baby pull them out one by one. Name each color.

title: Water Pouring
instructions: Give baby two cups and water. Demonstrate pouring from one to another. Great for coordination.

title: Hide and Seek Toy
description: Hide toy under cups and find it
instructions: Place 2-3 cups upside down. Hide a small toy under one. Ask baby to find it.

title: Color Sorting
description: Sort objects by color into containers
instructions: Use different colored objects (blocks, balls, lids). Place containers and ask child to sort by color.

title: Body Parts Game
description: Point to and name body parts
instructions: Touch your nose, ears, eyes and name them. Ask child to copy. Sing head-shoulders-knees song.

title: Follow the Leader
instructions: Do simple actions: jump, clap, spin, stomp. Ask child to follow. Then let them lead.

title: Puzzle Time
instructions: Give child a simple 3-5 piece puzzle. Guide them to match shapes. Celebrate each placed piece.

title: Sticker Play
description: Peel and stick stickers on paper
instructions: Give child stickers and paper. Peeling stickers builds fine motor skills. Create a picture together.

title: Nature Walk
instructions: Go on a short walk. Collect leaves, stones, flowers. Talk about colors, shapes and textures.

title: Drum Circle
description: Make rhythms with pots and spoons
instructions: Turn pots upside down as drums. Use wooden spoons as drumsticks. Create rhythms together.

title: Rice Sensory Bin
description: Explore rice with hands and tools
instructions: Fill a container with rice. Add cups, spoons, small toys. Let child scoop, pour and search.

title: Blanket Swing
description: Gently swing baby in a blanket
instructions: Two adults hold blanket corners with baby inside. Gently swing side to side while singing.

title: Musical Instruments
instructions:
1. Give baby safe instruments like shakers
2. Play music and shake along
3. Sing songs together
4. Let baby explore sounds

title: Sensory Bottle
description: Rəngli maye ilə dolu şüşə körpənin diqqətini cəlb edir
instructions: Plastik şüşəyə rəngli su və ya parıldayan materiallar əlavə edin. Qapağı möhkəm bağlayın. Körpəyə göstərin və yuvarlamağa icazə verin.

title: Hand Holding & Grasping
description: Let baby practice grasping your fingers
instructions: Offer your fingers for baby to grasp. Gently pull to encourage gripping strength.

title: Fabric Feel
instructions: Gather soft, rough, smooth, fluffy fabrics. Let baby touch and feel each one while naming the texture.

title: Rattle Shake
description: Baby shakes rattle to make sounds
instructions: Give baby a rattle and demonstrate shaking. Celebrate when baby copies you. Try different rhythms.

title: Ice Cube Painting
description: Paint with colored ice cubes on paper
instructions: Freeze water with food coloring. Let baby slide ice on paper to make colorful patterns.

title: Egg Carton Sorter
description: Sort small objects into egg carton holes
instructions: Place safe small objects nearby. Show baby how to put one in each egg carton slot. Count as you go.

title: Laundry Helper
instructions: Mix different colored socks together. Ask baby to find matching pairs by color.

title: Shadow Play
description: Make shadow puppets on the wall
instructions: In a dark room, use a flashlight to make hand shadows on the wall. Make animals and objects.

title: Washing Toys
instructions: Fill a tub with warm soapy water. Give baby sponge and toys to wash. Name each toy while washing.

title: Counting Game
instructions: Gather small objects like blocks. Count them together one by one. Make groups of 2, 3, 4.

title: Animal Sounds
instructions: Point to animal pictures in a book. Make the sound for each animal. Encourage baby to copy.

title: Pillow Mountain
instructions: Arrange pillows and cushions as an obstacle course. Encourage baby to climb over and through.

title: Cardboard House
description: Create a play house from a big box
instructions: Cut windows and a door in a large box. Decorate together. Let child play inside.

title: Tunnel Crawl
instructions: Drape blankets over chairs to make a tunnel. Encourage child to crawl through. Place toys at the end.

title: Pasta Necklace
instructions: Use large tube pasta. Show child how to thread onto a string or shoelace. Great for fine motor.

title: Finger Painting
instructions: Put safe paint on paper. Let child use fingers and hands to create art. Talk about colors.
